column3: “Truth” renders faithfulness; “the city” supplies the pronoun’s referent.
“Houses of prostitutes” is plural instead of one house.
“He will not do anything” expands “not He.”
“Their own predictions” supplies the referent of “thus.”
Quivers and graves are plural instead of singular.
“Hearts” is plural where the Hebrew has a collective singular.
“Cages” is plural instead of one cage.
